name: Asia
overview: The Scriptures reveal Asia as a significant region in the early spread of the Gospel and the life of the early Church. At Pentecost, inhabitants from Asia were present in Jerusalem, highlighting the area's connection to the early Christian movement (Acts 2:9). The Apostle Paul and his companions were notably restricted by the Holy Spirit from preaching in Asia at certain times, indicating divine guidance in their missionary journeys (Acts 16:6). Despite this, Asia was home to congregations and churches that Paul visited and supported, as seen in his travels and the companions who accompanied him from Asia (Acts 20:4, 20:16). Additionally, Jews from Asia played a role in the opposition Paul faced, demonstrating the region's complex religious dynamics (Acts 21:27, 24:18).
